permission.description: Enables the check_for_updates_command command without any pre-configured scope. This is the whole app manifest: one command, which takes no arguments, reads one hardcoded HTTPS URL (api.github.com's latest-release endpoint) and returns a version string. No filesystem, no shell, no token, no writes. Hand-written rather than autogenerated from build.rs so the allow list is a checked-in file a reviewer can read; the identifier is the one `AppManifest::new().commands(["check_for_updates_command"])` would produce, so moving to that route later changes no capability. Who may use it is decided in capabilities/check-for-updates.json, not here.
